items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio
items.why: 強化 Maya 場景匯出功能，包含角色骨盆偏移、縮放、深度及根運動權重調整，提升綁骨角色在外部工具的可用性。
items.why_en: Enhanced Maya Scene export, including adjustments for character pelvis offset, scale, depth, and root motion weight, improving usability of rigged characters in external tools.
